title: Kicked Spicy Moroccan King Prawns Rfissa
description: A spicy and flavorful Moroccan dish featuring king prawns, perfect for a date night, this rfissa recipe combines the sweetness of dates with the heat of spices, all in a satvik-friendly stir-fry.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the king prawns and cook until they turn pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the pitted dates and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot over rice or couscous.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
